\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 161-164 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R169-first-pass-words-from-chapters-161-164}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the heart and blood.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to sell, to boil, to fry, to grind, to mix
  \item to cross, to stay, to go around, to move, to lift
  \item to prepare, to serve, to share, to bargain, to check
  \item to describe, to hand over, to practise, to pass, to pay attention
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To sell? (\textbf{\ta{வில்}}, \emph{vil}.) To boil? (\textbf{\ta{கொதி}}, \emph{koti}.) To fry? (\textbf{\ta{வறு}}, \emph{vaṟu}.) To grind? (\textbf{\ta{அரை}}, \emph{arai}.) To mix? (\textbf{\ta{கலக்கு}}, \emph{kalakku}.) To cross? (\textbf{\ta{கட}}, \emph{kaṭa}.) To stay? (\textbf{\ta{தங்கு}}, \emph{taṅku}.) To go around? (\textbf{\ta{சுற்று}}, \emph{cuṟṟu}.) To move? (\textbf{\ta{நகர்}}, \emph{nakar}.) To lift? (\textbf{\ta{தூக்கு}}, \emph{tūkku}.) To prepare? (\textbf{\ta{தயார்} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{tayār cey}.) To serve? (\textbf{\ta{பரிமாறு}}, \emph{parimāṟu}.) To share? (\textbf{\ta{பகிர்}}, \emph{pakir}.) To bargain? (\textbf{\ta{பேரம்} \ta{பேசு}}, \emph{pēram pēcu}.) To check? (\textbf{\ta{சரிபார்}}, \emph{caripār}.) To describe? (\textbf{\ta{விவரி}}, \emph{vivari}.) To hand over? (\textbf{\ta{ஒப்படை}}, \emph{oppaṭai}.) To practise? (\textbf{\ta{பயிற்சி} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{payiṟci cey}.) To pass? (\textbf{\ta{தேர்ச்சி} \ta{பெறு}}, \emph{tērcci peṟu}.) To pay attention? (\textbf{\ta{கவனி}}, \emph{kavaṉi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 165-169 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R169-second-pass-words-from-chapters-165-169}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to get to know and to celebrate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get to know, to celebrate, to decorate, to dance, to worship
  \item to light a lamp, to burst, to put up with, to make peace, to consider
  \item to continue, to operate, to stick, to hang, to roll
  \item to plough, to dig, to stretch out, to slip, to yawn
  \item an ankle, the waist, the throat, the heart, blood
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get to know? (\textbf{\ta{பழகு}}, \emph{paḻaku}.) To celebrate? (\textbf{\ta{கொண்டாடு}}, \emph{koṇṭāṭu}.) To decorate? (\textbf{\ta{அலங்கரி}}, \emph{alaṅkari}.) To dance? (\textbf{\ta{நடனமாடு}}, \emph{naṭaṉamāṭu}.) To worship? (\textbf{\ta{வணங்கு}}, \emph{vaṇaṅku}.) To light a lamp? (\textbf{\ta{விளக்கேற்று}}, \emph{viḷakkēṟṟu}.) To burst? (\textbf{\ta{வெடி}}, \emph{veṭi}.) To put up with? (\textbf{\ta{பொறுத்துக்கொள்}}, \emph{poṟuttukkoḷ}.) To make peace? (\textbf{\ta{சமாதானம்} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{camātāṉam cey}.) To consider? (\textbf{\ta{யோசி}}, \emph{yōci}.) To continue? (\textbf{\ta{தொடர்}}, \emph{toṭar}.) To operate? (\textbf{\ta{இயக்கு}}, \emph{iyakku}.) To stick? (\textbf{\ta{ஒட்டு}}, \emph{oṭṭu}.) To hang? (\textbf{\ta{தொங்கு}}, \emph{toṅku}.) To roll? (\textbf{\ta{உருட்டு}}, \emph{uruṭṭu}.) To plough? (\textbf{\ta{உழு}}, \emph{uḻu}.) To dig? (\textbf{\ta{தோண்டு}}, \emph{tōṇṭu}.) To stretch out? (\textbf{\ta{நீட்டு}}, \emph{nīṭṭu}.) To slip? (\textbf{\ta{வழுக்கு}}, \emph{vaḻukku}.) To yawn? (\textbf{\ta{கொட்டாவி} \ta{விடு}}, \emph{koṭṭāvi viṭu}.) An ankle? (\textbf{\ta{கணுக்கால்}}, \emph{kaṇukkāl}.) The waist? (\textbf{\ta{இடுப்பு}}, \emph{iṭuppu}.) The throat? (\textbf{\ta{தொண்டை}}, \emph{toṇṭai}.) The heart? (\textbf{\ta{இதயம்}}, \emph{itayam}.) Blood? (\textbf{\ta{இரத்தம்}}, \emph{irattam}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
